Every periphery seen so far is a monotone unary wrapper or ts_decay_linear, and with the family in the controls those earn nothing. This slot tries two new axes: (1) state dynamics: ts_rank, cross_zscore, ts_stddev, cross_flat_ratio, ts_argmin, the 5-day minus 60-day mean, and S minus its 200-day version, plus the 60-day time-series correlation of S with the no-trade measures (day_flat_run_max(Close), day_zero_ratio(Ret)); (2) interactions with where the price is pinned (day_at_max_ratio / day_at_min_ratio of Vwap), the volume-weighted minute direction, and day_centroid(Volume).
